note: The methods and +3 rules checked on the held-out set, fixed in this file before any of them was run on it. They were developed on recall_carryover_set and the Step 0 conversations only. Only plan_1, plan_2 and plan_3 are the method in conversation_recall_plan.md G.9a; everything else exists only in the evaluation test, is not in the app, and is not approved.

methods.description: No carry-over: each message searched on its own, as the app does today.
The plan's rule: also search the previous user message; add everything it matches.
The plan's rule with two previous user messages.
The plan's rule with three previous user messages.
Add only memories the previous message matched whose similarity to the new message is at least the stated minimum.

A message sets the subject when it matches a memory confidently: by meaning and keywords together, by meaning with a stand-out of at least the stated value, or through a section of a long message. Those memories are kept as the current subject. A message with no confident match of its own is sent its own matches and then the current subject's memories. A later confident match replaces the subject.
subject_anchor, but the subject is dropped after it has been carried for the stated number of messages in a row.

plus_three_rules.description: A +3 memory must pass the same relevance gate as any other memory.
A +3 memory also passes when its similarity is at least the ordinary floor and its stand-out is at least the stated value.
lower_bar, but only when that +3 memory is the single most similar memory to the message.
